purpose: Machine-readable principal separation per issue #59, adapted to the #72 single-human constraint with an explicit owner waiver and named compensating controls.

prohibited_acts: authoring and approving the same head without disclosure
bypass without a prior durable record
merge to protected branches without owner approval
posting records titled as owner decisions (standing rule of 2026-08-08)

permitted_acts: read-only audit of both repositories and live GitHub state
prohibited_acts: any repository-content write, merge, ruleset, issue, secret, environment, or administration act (#59 item 7)

prohibited_combinations.rule: A principal that authored or pushed the current head cannot satisfy the human-approval requirement for that head without an explicit disclosure record; platform enforcement (no self-approval) applies unconditionally.

The same principal cannot be recorded as both the independent red-team reviewer and the human approver for one head unless the non-independence is disclosed verbatim in the review marker (the owner-selected both-keys flow), and H9 independent audit remains mandatory.
Review-only principals hold zero write authority of any class.

compensating_controls: context-free hourly independent audit (has detected and driven correction of real violations)
platform-required checks on both repositories with bypass_actors empty
H9 genuinely independent whole-repository audit before H10
standing owner-account provenance rule (R-PROV-001 resolution record)
single_human_waiver.review_trigger: Re-evaluate this waiver if any second human principal joins the program

account_id_semantics: account_id is the GitHub numeric user ID and is the DURABLE principal identity (owner decision D4, issue-156-comment-5248859501); account (login) is a cross-checked alias. A login rename does not transfer or revoke identity: on login/account_id mismatch the consumer must fail closed with a distinct reason code until an owner-authorized matrix update records the new alias. account_id is null for non-GitHub-account automation principals. Values read live 2026-08-11 via the GitHub users API and cross-verified against owner comment actor id 299649366 on issue-156-comment-5248859501.
